title: Frontend Developer

title: Backend Developer
description: Builds APIs, handles server logic, authentication, database operations, and backend performance.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Works on both frontend and backend with end-to-end application development responsibility.

title: Data Analyst
description: Analyzes data to extract insights using Python, SQL, Excel, and visualization tools.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Builds ML models, prepares datasets, deploys models using Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn.

title: DevOps Engineer

title: Android Developer
description: Builds Android applications using Java, Kotlin, and Android Studio.

title: iOS Developer

title: Cybersecurity Analyst

title: Cloud Engineer
